decoration: moderate — a few SVG blobs or grid lines
hero_layout: asymmetric offset — text heavy on one side, visual peeking from edge
nav_style: bottom bar — fixed navigation at the bottom
card_style: cards with colored left/top accent border
scroll_animation: none — everything static and immediately visible
hover_effects: moderate — scale, shadow change, color transitions
contact_style: big bold email as hero text
spacing_density: ultra-spacious — luxury feel, huge gaps between sections
quirk: contact section looks like a terminal / command line
bonus_quirk: include a CSS-only dark/light mode toggle switch
